{{Short description|French astrophysicist, writer and poet}}
{{Expand French|Michel Cassé|date=October 2012|topic=sci}}
'''Michel Cassé''', is a French astrophysicist, writer and poet born in [[Fleurance]] in [[Gers]] in 1943.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.parvisdesgentils.fr/orateurs.html|title=Parvis des Gentils: orateurs|year=2011|language=French|accessdate=10 November 2011|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905084916/http://www.parvisdesgentils.fr/orateurs.html|archivedate=5 September 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sudouest.fr/2010/08/08/michel-casse-pour-l-amour-du-ciel-156320-2386.php|title=Michel Cassé, pour l'amour du ciel |last=Galiacy |first=Jean-Charles |date=2010-08-08|publisher=[[Sud-Ouest (newspaper)|Sud-Ouest]]|language=French|accessdate=10 November 2011}}</ref> He works at CEA ([[Commissariat à l'énergie atomique]]),  and at [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] ([[CNRS]]) and specializes [[nucleosynthesis]] and [[quantum mechanics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.eveprogramme.com/en/page/michel-cass%C3%A9|title=Plenary speakers: Michel Cassé|publisher=Programme EVE|accessdate=10 November 2011|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120425154257/http://www.eveprogramme.com/en/page/michel-cass%C3%A9|archivedate=25 April 2012}}</ref> 

== Publications ==
* ''Stellar Alchemy: The Celestial Origin of Atoms'', 2003 with Stephen Lyle {{ISBN|978-0-521-82182-7}}
* ''Astrophysique'' (in French), 2011, éditions Jean-Paul Bayol, {{ISBN|978-2-916913-33-9}}
* ''Nostalgie de la Lumière'' (in French), Belfond, {{ISBN|978-2-7144-2099-2}}
*''Les Trous noirs en pleine lumière'' (in French), 2009, Odile Jacob, {{ISBN|978-2-7381-2077-9}}
*''Cosmologie dite à Rimbaud'' (in French), 2007, éditions Jean-Paul Bayol, {{ISBN|978-2-916913-05-6}}
*''Théories du ciel. Espace perdu, temps retrouvé'' (in French), 2005, Rivages, {{ISBN|2-7436-1421-8}}
*''Énergie noire, matière noire'' (in French), 2004, Odile Jacob, {{ISBN|2-7381-1325-7}}
* ''Du vide et de la création'' (in French), 2001, Odile Jacob, {{ISBN|2-7381-0976-4}}
* ''Généalogie de la matière. Retour aux sources célestes des éléments'' 2000 (in French), Odile Jacob, {{ISBN|2-7381-0846-6}}
